meta.title: Foyer
meta.description: Set rules for your AI assistants so they don’t spend or book without agreement.

home.title: Keep your AI assistants from fighting over your money.
home.lead: One bot books travel. Another watches the budget. They both act in your name, but they want different things. You write the rules. Foyer checks each request against those rules before anything is paid or booked.

wizard.qFinance: May finance block a spend over the monthly limit?

outline.constitutionLead: You write what is allowed. Every assistant follows the same text. The court reads it too.
outline.gatewayLead: An assistant cannot pay, book, or message the outside world on its own. It asks through Foyer. If nobody objects, it goes through.
outline.courtLead: If they disagree, the court decides: go ahead, block it, find a middle, or ask you. If it cannot decide, you decide. You can appeal.

legal.title: Legal notice
legal.lead: Foyer is a public test. Not a company, not legal advice, not a bank.
legal.body: Assistants of one person or company share a wallet and a name, not a goal. They ask through Foyer. If they deadlock, GenLayer reads your rules and answers: go ahead, block, a compromise, or ask you. The house wallet holds test GEN for court fees. Do not put real money or production agents here.
legal.contact: Questions: leave an email on the home page.

privacy.title: What we store
privacy.lead: Only what the house needs to run.
privacy.body: Wallet address when you sign in — that is the account. Email if you join the waitlist. Hashed IP on public writes, for rate limits, no request bodies. Agent keys stay in your runtime; we keep a hash. Rules, cases, and transfers sit in our database for your house. Court transactions go to GenLayer.
